name: Plugin Drawer
author: Aly Sarhan
description: Collapse chosen bar plugins into a tray-style drawer. Grid and list views with drag-and-drop reordering and a live preview of each plugin's bar icon; the grid stretches to fill the drawer width and the drawer adapts to the screen. Hide/unhide plugins via an eye toggle, with a show-hidden reveal in the drawer
